name: agent-project-governance
description: Support task continuity, source realignment, worktree boundaries, and recovery without replacing project authorities

interface.shortDescription: Continue real development tasks without replacing project authorities.
interface.longDescription: A developer-preview continuity layer for context recovery, task-source realignment, and worktree-boundary evidence. Existing bootstrap, delivery, closeout, and hook entry points remain auxiliary and reuse project authorities rather than creating another plan or orchestration system.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this project and preview its governance setup.
Resume this work unit and recommend the next safe action.
Refresh this task's workspace evidence before writing.
Verify the current candidate before merge or cleanup.
